gripOrHq.title: Team Restructuring
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Planning Consultants
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Look at the top five cards of R&D and arrange them in any order you choose.

heapOrArchives.title: Encoder, Inc.
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Code gates cost [1] less to rez while Encoder, Inc. is rezzed. All code gates have an additional "End the run" subroutine after all other subroutines.

heapOrArchives.title: Systematic Layoffs
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Canis Major
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +2 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: Systematic Layoffs
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Bizarre Encryption Scheme
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Bizarre Encryption Scheme may only be installed in a subsidiary data fort. Runner does not score any agenda (or agendas) that he or she accesses from this fort; return the agenda to the fort instead. Runner scores the agenda at the start of his or her next turn if it is still in the fort.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

scoreArea.title: Employee Empowerment
scoreArea.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Shredder Uplink Protocol
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, treat run as a successful run on HQ.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.
